"DRM42L2 V1.3" and "08-04DRM4213" are silkscreened on the board.
It's a 4-bay 1U Rackmount NAS. This device has 2x USB 3.0 and 1x eSATA ports.
{{See also|List of NAS Devices}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Marvell]] MV78260 @1.33GHz :Dual-core ''Armada XP'' (ARM v7) *Memory: 1GB (DDR3) SDRAM *Storage: 8MB (SPI NOR) Flash, :4x SATA II, 1x eSATA slots *Network: 2x Gigabit Ethernet port *USB: 2x USB 3.0 ports *Power: ~100-240V, 3.5A via C13
